projects.title: Everfresh Dairy Farms Free-Stall Barn (Phase 1)
projects.overview: Modern agricultural and dairy livestock facility engineered with heavy-duty green-primed steel portal frames, wide clear spans, and high-efficiency natural ridge cooling monitors.
projects.challenge: Maintaining continuous natural air circulation while keeping inside temperatures 6°C cooler than ambient heatwave conditions without mechanical HVAC.
projects.solution: Engineered high-pitched gable roof frames with continuous automated ridge monitors and double-skin profiled sheeting with thermal insulation.
projects.result: Delivered turnkey 14 days ahead of deadline with zero operational downtime for livestock transfer.

projects.title: Falcon High-Bay Logistics & Distribution Park
projects.overview: State-of-the-art clear-span distribution terminal built for multi-tier automated racking systems and 24/7 cross-docking operations.
projects.challenge: Complete elimination of interior columns over a 64-meter width to accommodate 3-tier VNA reach trucks.
projects.solution: Parametric tapered portal frames fabricated with ASTM A572 Grade 50 high-tensile steel with submerged arc welding.
projects.result: Achieved 100% column-free floor space and full FM Global wind-uplift compliance.

projects.title: Crescent Textile High-Speed Weaving Complex
projects.overview: Massive industrial weaving facility housing 260 high-speed air-jet looms requiring absolute humidity control and structural vibration dampening.
projects.challenge: Heavy dynamic loads from weaving machinery and suspension of high-capacity HVAC ducting.
projects.solution: Designed reinforced rafter connections and vibration-isolating column footings calculated via STAAD.Pro finite element analysis.
projects.result: Operating smoothly at 99.8% structural efficiency with zero resonance issues.

projects.title: Simson Dairies Modern Milking Parlor & Cow Shed
projects.overview: Modern automated milking parlor and livestock housing facility built with precision-aligned steel portal frames and heavy-duty corrosion-resistant finishes.
projects.challenge: High ammonia and moisture corrosion protection combined with wide clear-span animal transit corridors.
projects.solution: Utilized heavy hot-dip galvanized and epoxy-primed steel sections with continuous mechanical ridge ventilation.
projects.result: Successfully commissioned providing comfortable thermal shelter for high-yield dairy cattle.

projects.title: Simson Dairies Heavy Structural Steel Barn & Feed Facility
projects.overview: High-clearance agricultural steel framing facility engineered for fodder storage, automated feed distribution, and heavy equipment access.
projects.challenge: Severe soil conditions and dynamic loads from overhead automated agricultural equipment.
projects.solution: Custom engineered rafter connections and reinforced anchor bolt footings with heavy mobile crane erection.
projects.result: Completed on schedule with robust structural integrity and maximum interior utility.

projects.title: Everfresh Dairy Farms High-Ventilation Shed
projects.overview: Large-scale dairy cow housing shed engineered with open-sided portal frames, elevated ridge monitors, and insulated standing roof sheeting.
projects.challenge: Minimizing heat stress in livestock during extreme summer temperatures exceeding 45°C.
projects.solution: Engineered high eave height, aerodynamic roof monitors, and wide eaves providing full shade and natural cross-draft.
projects.result: Delivered optimal animal welfare and maximum milk production efficiency.

projects.title: Nishat Corrugated Packaging & Paper Shed
projects.overview: High-output corrugator and printing facility with integrated day-lighting systems reducing daytime lighting energy needs by 60%.
projects.challenge: Large continuous open floor area for high-speed corrugator line with strict fire safety water storage requirements.
projects.solution: Clear span frames engineered with reinforced rafter nodes supporting high-capacity fire sprinkler network.
projects.result: Handed over turnkey 3 weeks ahead of machine import arrival.

projects.title: Engro Chemical Fertilizer Bulk Storage Terminal
projects.overview: Heavy bulk fertilizer warehouse capable of withstanding lateral thrust pressures from 8-meter high bulk material heaps.
projects.challenge: Extreme chemical dust corrosive atmosphere and heavy conveyor truss suspension.
projects.solution: Specially formulated polyurethane protective coating with 280-micron DFT and high-tensile connection bolts.
projects.result: Operational with zero structural fatigue through multiple seasonal fertilizer peaks.

projects.title: Auto Parts Precision Die-Casting Foundry Shed
projects.overview: Aluminum die-casting foundry facility with specialized roof heat dispersion systems and heavy crane beam runways.
projects.challenge: Very high localized ambient thermal temperatures directly above induction furnaces.
projects.solution: Engineered heat-deflector baffle plates and oversized aerodynamic gravity ventilators.
projects.result: Optimal operator environment temperature maintained even during peak summer production.

projects.title: National Grain Silo Headhouse & Distribution Shed
projects.overview: High-throughput grain intake and mechanical distribution building connecting to 50,000-ton concrete storage silos.
projects.challenge: Wind loading on tall, narrow structural towers during severe seasonal dust storms.
projects.solution: Braced structural steel frame engineered to 160 km/h wind velocity rating per UBC-97.
projects.result: Protected Pakistan's national grain reserves with zero downtime during storm seasons.

projects.title: Kohinoor Textile Spinning Mill Expansion
projects.overview: Seamless expansion of an active spinning plant with precision steel framing erected alongside operational spinning machinery.
projects.challenge: Zero construction vibration or dust infiltration allowed into adjacent operational spinning lines.
projects.solution: Modular prefabricated bolted steel assemblies lifted and bolted during scheduled weekend maintenance shifts.
projects.result: Zero production hours lost during the entire 5-month expansion period.

projects.title: Commercial Wholesale Steel Hypermarket & Terminal
projects.overview: Modern retail-wholesale trade center blending pre-engineered steel economics with architectural glass facade aesthetics.
projects.challenge: Interfacing sleek architectural glass curtain walling with flexible steel building envelope tolerances.
projects.solution: Engineered slotted deflection clip connections accommodating seismic drift while preserving glass warranty.
projects.result: A striking commercial landmark recognized for architectural steel excellence.

projects.title: Punjab Dairies Modern Milking Parlor & Cow Barn
projects.overview: State-of-the-art free-stall dairy barn and automated rotary milking center designed for maximum bovine welfare and yield.
projects.challenge: Highly corrosive organic slurry and high humidity causing rapid degradation in standard steel.
projects.solution: Hot-dip galvanized columns up to 2.5m height and stainless steel hardware in all high-contact livestock zones.
projects.result: Maintains optimal animal comfort index and exceptional structure durability.

projects.title: Pakistan Railways Locomotive Maintenance Depot
projects.overview: Heavy industrial rail maintenance shed built over deep inspection pits with high-tonnage overhead crane runways.
projects.challenge: Strict historic site interface and integration with legacy narrow-gauge track networks.
projects.solution: 3D laser-scanned foundation alignment ensuring zero millimeter discrepancy in crane rail elevation.
projects.result: Completed to full federal engineering standards and operational for locomotive servicing.

projects.title: Comet Sports Clear-Span Production Facility
projects.overview: State-of-the-art export sports manufacturing facility in Sialkot, Punjab, engineered with 135-foot column-free clear spans and 100 metric tons of high-tensile precision pre-engineered steel.
projects.challenge: Eliminating intermediate columns across a wide 135-foot span while keeping total steel structural weight under 100 metric tons for optimal material efficiency.
projects.solution: Engineered parametric tapered built-up portal frames fabricated with ASTM A572 Grade 50 steel and submerged arc welding.
projects.result: Achieved a 100% column-free manufacturing floor delivered in 6 months on schedule.

projects.title: Comet Sports Export Logistics & Storage Hub
projects.overview: State-of-the-art export logistics warehouse engineered for finished goods storage, high-density pallet racking, and container cross-docking.
projects.challenge: Rapid execution required to meet international export seasonal shipment commitments.
projects.solution: Pre-engineered computerized Tekla LOD 400 modeling enabling parallel foundation casting and fast-track steel erection.
projects.result: Handed over 20 days ahead of deadline with zero container loading bottlenecks.

projects.title: Comet Sports Clear-Span Assembly Complex
projects.overview: Massive clear-span industrial assembly hall engineered with lightweight tapered steel rafters and integrated natural daylighting panels.
projects.challenge: Uniform illumination and high ventilation standards required for precision sports ball stitching and quality inspection.
projects.solution: Designed high-profile rafters with integrated 15% roof polycarbonate light strips and aerodynamic roof ridge vents.
projects.result: Reduced factory daytime lighting power consumption by 40% while maintaining superior structural rigidity.

faqs.q: What makes Pre-Engineered Buildings superior to conventional RCC structures?
faqs.a: PEB systems use high-tensile steel members tapered according to bending moment diagrams, reducing dead weight by up to 30%. They fabricate in controlled factory environments concurrently with foundation work, cutting total project completion time by 40-50% while offering superior earthquake resistance.

faqs.q: What is the maximum clear span Aitmaad can fabricate without internal columns?
faqs.a: We regularly engineer and fabricate clear spans up to 75-90 meters without interior support columns. This provides 100% usable floor area for warehousing, aircraft hangars, and assembly lines.

faqs.q: How does Aitmaad ensure waterproofing on PEB roofs?
faqs.a: We utilize double-locked 360-degree standing seam metal roofing systems with concealed clips. Because fasteners do not penetrate the external roof sheet, thermal expansion does not cause elongation or water leakage.

faqs.q: Can Aitmaad integrate heavy overhead cranes into a PEB design?
faqs.a: Yes. Our engineers design the primary columns with stepped brackets or independent crane runway columns to support electric overhead traveling (EOT) cranes up to 50-ton capacity, fully compliant with CMAA guidelines.

faqs.q: What is the typical lifespan and maintenance required for an Aitmaad PEB?
faqs.a: Engineered to ASTM and AISC standards, our structures have a design service life exceeding 50 years. Periodic gutter cleaning and 10-year surface touch-ups are all that is typically required.

faqs.q: What welding certifications do Aitmaad welders possess?
faqs.a: All Aitmaad shop and field welders are certified to AWS D1.1 in 3G/4G positions. We employ full-time Certified Welding Inspectors (CWI) to verify every joint.

faqs.q: How are fabrication tolerances maintained?
faqs.a: We adhere strictly to AISC Code of Standard Practice (AISC 303). CNC beam-drilling, plasma plate cutting, and laser alignment ensure millimetric bolt hole tolerances and smooth site erection.

faqs.q: Do you supply heavy conveyor gantries and pipe racks for process plants?
faqs.a: Yes. We have fabricated and erected overhead utility bridges, trestles, and pipe racks for leading fertilizer, textile, and chemical manufacturers across Pakistan.

faqs.q: What non-destructive testing (NDT) reports do you provide?
faqs.a: We provide comprehensive Quality Assurance documentation including mill test certificates (MTC), ultrasonic testing (UT) reports for moment weld splices, magnetic particle inspection (MPI), and dry film thickness (DFT) paint logs.

faqs.q: Can Aitmaad erect structures in congested or active operating industrial facilities?
faqs.a: Yes. Our erection methodologies include rigorous HAZOP analysis, sequenced crane lift plans, and night-shift installations to eliminate disruption to active plant operations.

faqs.q: How do you prevent thermal bridging in cold storage steel structures?
faqs.a: We engineer heavy-duty composite thermal isolator pads under baseplates, use non-conductive sleeve fasteners, and install ceiling sandwich panels below the roof steel to eliminate thermal shorts.

faqs.q: Can Aitmaad coordinate the laser-screed FM2 floor for VNA reach trucks?
faqs.a: Yes. For high-density racking, floor flatness is paramount. We design and deliver jointless steel-fiber reinforced concrete slabs meeting TR34 FM2 specifications.

faqs.q: What fire safety certifications do your insulated panels carry?
faqs.a: Our PIR panels are certified to EN 13501-1 Class B-s1,d0 and FM Global approvals, ensuring self-extinguishing performance and low smoke emissions.

faqs.q: What is the typical build time for a 100,000 sq. ft. distribution warehouse?
faqs.a: From approved foundation handover, Aitmaad delivers steel frame, cladding, and docking bays in approximately 120 to 140 days.

faqs.q: Do you supply cold room insulated sliding doors and docking shelters?

faqs.a: Yes. We engineer natural convection systems, including continuous throat ridge monitors and louvers that exhaust hot air without mechanical power.

faqs.q: How do you handle heavy loads hanging from roof trusses (e.g., HVAC ducts, cable trays)?

faqs.q: What is the difference between standing seam roofing and screw-down trapezoidal sheets?
faqs.a: Screw-down sheets have thousands of exposed screws that penetrate the sheet, which can leak over time as thermal movement stretches the holes. Standing seam panels clip together with concealed fasteners and 360-degree mechanical seaming, providing 100% leak-proof reliability.

faqs.q: What is Galvalume (Zincalume) and why is it superior to ordinary galvanized steel?
faqs.a: Galvalume features an alloy coating of 55% aluminum, 43.4% zinc, and 1.6% silicon. It provides up to four times the corrosion resistance of standard hot-dip galvanized steel in harsh industrial atmospheres.

faqs.q: Can you re-roof an old, leaking industrial factory without stopping factory operations?
faqs.a: Yes. Our 'Over-Roofing' technique installs light sub-purlins over your existing asbestos or corrugated sheets, allowing new insulated standing seam roofing to be placed without opening the building to the sky.

faqs.q: What insulation thickness is recommended for hot Pakistani summers?
faqs.a: For general manufacturing, a 50mm glasswool or 50mm PIR panel is effective. For air-conditioned facilities, we recommend 80mm to 100mm PIR panels to reduce HVAC power consumption significantly.

faqs.q: Are the skylight panels shatter-proof and UV-resistant?
faqs.a: We install heavy-duty polycarbonate and FRP sheets co-extruded with UV-blocking barriers that resist yellowing, hail damage, and embrittlement for over 15 years.

faqs.q: How can Aitmaad's engineering team reduce my project's steel tonnage?
faqs.a: By utilizing tapered plate girders matching precise moment envelopes instead of heavy standard hot-rolled I-beams, we eliminate wasted steel at low-stress points. This typically yields a 15-20% reduction in total steel tonnage.

faqs.q: Do you supply certified structural calculation reports for municipal and DHA/industrial estate approval?
faqs.a: Yes. Every project includes a signed and stamped structural design calculation report by a registered Professional Engineer (PE) holding Pakistan Engineering Council (PEC) licensing.

faqs.q: What is Tekla LOD 400 detailing and why is it important?
faqs.a: LOD 400 means every plate, stiffener, weld, bolt, and hole is modeled in a 3D digital twin before cutting begins. This guarantees zero clashes on site and eliminates expensive field modifications.

faqs.q: Can Aitmaad review an existing steel design from another consultant?
faqs.a: Yes. We offer independent peer review services to identify over-designed elements, eliminate erection bottlenecks, and verify seismic compliance.

faqs.q: How long does the initial engineering design phase take?
faqs.a: Preliminary GA (General Arrangement) and anchor bolt drawings are typically ready within 7-10 working days after client architectural freeze.
